source: Togo OCHA settlement catalog (Other license), analysis-only temporary XLSX
restoration: sources/acquisition.json: Togo settlement package `togo-settlements`, resource `tgo_settlement_20210420.dbf.xlsx`; license must be reviewed before any copy is retained
source_date: 2021-04-20 in resource name; catalog resource last modified 2021-04-27
comparison_input: Retained OCHA WCA CC BY settlement subset, Togo rows, with GeoJSON point geometry, featureNam, and admin2Pcod
comparison_method: Unicode NFKD ASCII lowercase alphanumeric name normalization + exact admin2 pcode; where repeated source workbook rows shared a name/code, compare to the nearest WGS84 coordinate candidate using the GeoJSON geometry as longitude/latitude and workbook LONG/LAT
attribute_axis_finding: All WCA point records have GeoJSON geometry X/Y equal to the catalog LAT/LONG property fields in reverse label order (within 1e-6 degrees); the geometry agrees with the separate Togo workbook LONG/LAT values for 5273 of 5276 name+code matches within 10 m. Use GeoJSON point geometry; do not interpret the regional LAT/LONG property names conventionally.
limits: The separate OCHA country workbook is cataloged with license `Other` and was not retained; this coordinate screen is an analysis summary, not a redistributable source snapshot.
Repeated names/code candidates make the nearest-coordinate comparison non-unique for 316 features.
The 118 unmatched names/code rows and three matched points beyond 10 m need source/vintage review; they are not automatically corrected.
This proves neither complete settlement coverage nor administrative ownership.
